title: execute or deny controlled canary activation through AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine gates

files.role: controlled canary activation gate evaluation and denial projection script
controlled activation handoff for rollback drill

criteria: The projection script consumes RC9-010 publication denial, RC9-011 drift denial, RC9-012 fetch denial, RC9-020 target enrollment denial, and RC9-021 execution binding denial before evaluating activation.
The activation gate report records activation-gates-evaluated-denied with activation_allowed=false and activation_performed=false.

The activation denial evidence covers external object URI, drift, fetch, target enrollment, exact approval, AgentCore PlanSpec, SecurityExecutionEngine, remote dispatch, and controlled execution authorization blockers.
The controlled activation handoff moves the workflow to RC9-030 while rollback execution remains denied.
The task preserves production_ready_claim=false and does not mutate install, activation, rollback, active slot, boot metadata, production ring, support upload, or remote dispatch state.
